_comment: Compiled-in SHA-256 integrity pins for the Chromium that POST /v1/runtime/install-chromium downloads. Keyed by the Chromium REVISION (the NNNN in the `chromium-NNNN` install dir) -> platform-key -> lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the LAUNCHABLE browser executable (the exact per-OS binary chromium_exe_candidates() resolves). runtime_setup::verify_downloaded_chromium() consults this table after an install succeeds and BEFORE InstallState::Done; a mismatch OR a missing pin fails closed (InstallState::Error, refuse to proceed). Platform keys mirror the AUTO_UPDATE.md artifact keys: macos-aarch64, macos-x86_64, windows-x86_64, linux-x86_64.
_source: These are OPEN-SOURCE CHROMIUM (BSD-3-Clause) builds from the Chromium project's own snapshot bucket (https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/chromium-browser-snapshots/<platform>/<revision>/), NOT 'Google Chrome for Testing' — which is what patchright/playwright download and which is Google-copyrighted under the Chrome Terms of Service. The revision IS the Chromium main-branch position, pinned to a stable release's position. The per-platform revisions differ because the snapshot bucket does not publish every position for every platform; each is the nearest available build at or below the stable position 1654411.
_bump_procedure: To move the Chromium pin: (1) pick the new stable branch position from https://chromiumdash.appspot.com/fetch_releases?channel=Stable, (2) for each platform find the nearest available position with a build, (3) update the matching consts in browser/chromium_download.rs::HOST_BUILD, (4) recompute each hash with: curl -sfL <archive-url> -o a.zip && unzip -p a.zip '<exe-path-in-archive>' | shasum -a 256, (5) add a NEW top-level revision block here — never edit an old one, so an already-installed browser keeps verifying.
